prefixDef.p: URIs using the q prefix are Wikidata Q identifiers and refer to the respective entries on Wikidata.
Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: Long ago a rich person had a worker, an orphan girl. The rich one oppressed [her] strongly. Once the girl went for water. Standing on the shore of the river, she cried and said to the sun: "Sun, take me". Suddenly she flew to the sun. The sun had taken her. Until now the girl is standing on the sun, it is living there until now.
